english.note: Speakers use this colloquial term especially for a psychologist who counsels or treats clients, rather than a psychology researcher.
This is the everyday all-purpose term for a mental-health professional in the casual sense of English “shrink”.

examples.english: I want to see a psychologist and talk things through; I've been under a lot of stress lately.
examples.traditional: 我想搵心理醫生傾吓，最近壓力真係好大。

examples.english: With all this stress lately, why don't you see a shrink and talk things over?
examples.traditional: 最近壓力咁大，不如搵個心理醫生傾吓啦。
